presets.name: 能量波冲击
presets.description: 环形能量波从文字中心向外扩散，配合发光+色散+冲击波变形。对标龙珠/火影能量释放特效
presets.jsx_template: (function(){var _r={};try{var c=app.project.activeItem;if(!c||!(c instanceof CompItem)){_r={status:'error',message:'No active comp'};return JSON.stringify(_r);}var n='{{textLayerName}}';var L=null;for(var i=1;i<=c.numLayers;i++){if(c.layer(i).name==n){L=c.layer(i);break;}}if(!L||!(L instanceof TextLayer)){_r={status:'error',message:'Text layer not found'};return JSON.stringify(_r);}var d={{duration}};try{var td=L.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Document');var tv=td.value;tv.fontSize={{fontSize}};tv.fillColor=[1,1,1];tv.justification=ParagraphJustification.CENTER_JUSTIFY;td.setValue(tv);}catch(fe){}L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Position').setValue([960,540]);var waveCount={{waveCount}};var maxR={{waveRadius}};for(var wi=0;wi<waveCount;wi++){var ring=c.layers.addSolid([0.3,0.8,1],'Wave_'+wi,1920,1080,1);ring.blendingMode=BlendingMode.ADD;try{var ell=ring.property('Effects').addProperty('ADBE ELLP');ell.property('ADBE ELLP-0003').setValue([960,540]);ell.property('ADBE ELLP-0001').setValue(1);ell.property('ADBE ELLP-0002').setValue([10,10]);}catch(re){}var delay=wi*0.15;ring.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Scale').setValueAtTime(delay,[10,10]);ring.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Scale').setValueAtTime(delay+0.5,[maxR/10,maxR/10]);ring.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValueAtTime(delay,80);ring.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValueAtTime(delay+0.5,0);}L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Scale').setValueAtTime(0,[120,120]);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Scale').setValueAtTime(0.15,[95,95]);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Scale').setValueAtTime(0.3,[100,100]);var glow=L.property('Effects').addProperty('ADBE Glo2');glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0002').setValue(0.1);glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0003').setValue(35);glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0004').setValue(3.0);try{glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0005').setValue(3);glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0006').setValue([0.3,0.8,1,1]);glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0007').setValue([0.1,0.4,0.8,1]);}catch(ge){}L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValueAtTime(0,0);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValueAtTime(0.1,100);_r={status:'success',preset:'vfx_energy_wave',layer:n,waves:waveCount};}catch(e){_r={status:'error',message:e.toString()};}return JSON.stringify(_r);})();

presets.name: 魔法阵召唤
presets.description: 旋转魔法阵从文字下方浮现，配合符文旋转+光芒发射+逐层展开。对标Fate/Re:Zero召唤阵
presets.jsx_template: (function(){var _r={};try{var c=app.project.activeItem;if(!c||!(c instanceof CompItem)){_r={status:'error',message:'No active comp'};return JSON.stringify(_r);}var n='{{textLayerName}}';var L=null;for(var i=1;i<=c.numLayers;i++){if(c.layer(i).name==n){L=c.layer(i);break;}}if(!L||!(L instanceof TextLayer)){_r={status:'error',message:'Text layer not found'};return JSON.stringify(_r);}var d={{duration}};var radius={{circleRadius}};var layers_n={{layerCount}};var rotSpd={{rotationSpeed}};try{var td=L.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Glo2-0007').setValue([0.4,0.2,0.8,1]);}catch(ge){}L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValueAtTime(0,0);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValueAtTime(0.5,100);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValueAtTime(d-0.3,100);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE presets.name: 粒子爆炸扩散
